# lib/usb module

USB CDC-ACM virtual serial port for PIC18F2455, 2550, 4455 and 4550. This page is the reference for the `lib/usb` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

| Parts, PIC18Fxx5x | 18F2455, 18F2550, 18F4455, 18F4550 |
| Source files | `lib/usb/src/epic_usb.c`, `lib/usb/src/usb_descriptors.c`, `lib/usb/third_party/m-stack/usb/src/usb.c`, `lib/usb/third_party/m-stack/usb/src/usb_cdc.c` |
| Depends on | Nothing |

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family. Build it with the repository build driver, or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

| Family | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|
| PIC18Fxx5x | `usb-cdc` | [`lib/usb/examples/example_usb.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/usb/examples/example_usb.c) |

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/usb` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/usb). This page does not restate it. This is a documentation gap: the manifest carries no function list to generate a table from.
